How to Monetize MCP Tools — Complete Guide (2026)

Learn how to sell your MCP server on MarketNow. Seller tiers, pricing, payments, and revenue examples.

MarketNow's monetization model

MarketNow does NOT sell skills. We administer a free marketplace. Revenue comes from:

  1. Sentinel subscriptions (sellers pay for priority audits + analytics)
  2. Commission on seller-set prices (when a seller sells their skill)

Payment methods

  • USDC on Base (Layer 2) — instant, on-chain verified
  • Stripe (credit card) — full chargeback protection
  • Mandates (ACP/AP2) — pre-approved spending for agents

Revenue example

If you sell your MCP server at Free:

  • You receive: $3.99 (80%)
  • MarketNow receives: $1.00 (20%)

If an affiliate referred the buyer:

  • You receive: $3.99 (80%, unchanged)
  • MarketNow receives: $0.75 (15%)
  • Affiliate receives: $0.25 (5%)

Add-ons

  • Featured Listing: Free / 30 days (boost in search results)
  • Verified Seller Badge: Free one-time (KYC verification)
  • Priority Review: Free / skill (skip queue, <6h review)
  • Storage fee: free unlimited listings after 3 skills (FREE tier only)

How to start selling

  1. Build your MCP server
  2. Submit to marketnow.site/submit (free)
  3. Pass the 10-layer Sentinel audit
  4. Set your price (or keep it free)
  5. Agents discover and install your server
